heading: Professional Tax: Deduction, State Rules & Your ITR
tldr: Professional Tax is a state-level tax levied on individuals earning income through a profession or employment.
Not all Indian states impose Professional Tax; its applicability and rates vary significantly by state.
For salaried individuals, employers typically deduct Professional Tax from their gross salary.
You can claim the Professional Tax paid as a deduction from your gross salary under Section 16(iii) of the Income Tax Act.
This deduction reduces your taxable income, potentially lowering your overall income tax liability.
caption:
Ever wonder why your take-home salary is a bit less than you expect? One reason could be Professional Tax! It's a small tax some states collect from your income, and guess what? You can actually claim it back to lower your overall income tax. This means more money stays in your pocket! Learn how this tax works in your state and how to claim it in your ITR.
